verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents parsing of scans, page routing to High Res or VLM partitioning, and a generative OCR enrichment that uses a VLM to improve text fidelity. That covers the core of OCR on scanned documents, but nothing shows how it handles the harder cases the story names. Missing for 10: evidence for skewed pages, stamps, low-quality scans and photographed documents; any OCR accuracy benchmarks; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, scanned and photographed documents OCR accurately — skewed pages, stamps, low quality scans included

citations.quote: Parse PDFs, tables, forms and scans into structured data your agents can trust.
After partitioning, you can have a vision language model (VLM) optimize the fidelity of text blocks that Unstructured initially processed during its partitioning phase.
Auto evaluates each page and routes it to Fast, High Res, or VLM partitioning, balancing quality, speed, and cost.
Create a job to partition and enrich local files into AI-ready JSON with image descriptions, table HTML, named entities, and generative OCR output.
